manager.stdout:
usage: job_manager [-h] --store STORE --incarnation INCARNATION
                   --authority-uuid AUTHORITY_UUID
                   {submit,fresh-attempt,status,serve} ...

Submit Jobs to the v12 Job manager, read its status, or run its control loop.

positional arguments:
  {submit,fresh-attempt,status,serve}
    submit              record one versioned multi-Job submission
    fresh-attempt       admit a fresh attempt at a Job whose execution failed
    status              print the read-only status projection
    serve               run the persistent control loop

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --store STORE         the Job store's path; there is no default, and one
                        inside the checkout is what the external state root
                        exists to prevent
  --incarnation INCARNATION
                        this process's incarnation, which is what restart
                        recovery distinguishes managers by
  --authority-uuid AUTHORITY_UUID
                        the 32-lowercase-hex Authority this Job store belongs
                        to; it namespaces every episode identity the store
                        derives, is persisted on first open, and a later open
                        naming another one refuses without changing the store

manager-fresh-attempt.note: operands of the retry verb the retained candidate calls absent
manager-fresh-attempt.stdout:
usage: job_manager fresh-attempt [-h] --prior-job PRIOR_JOB --control CONTROL
                                 --authority AUTHORITY --instance INSTANCE
                                 [--route ROUTE] [--job-id JOB_ID]
                                 [--work-id WORK_ID]
                                 [--submission-id SUBMISSION_ID]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --prior-job PRIOR_JOB
                        the retained failed Job this repeats; its submitted
                        specification, limits and scope are carried forward
                        unchanged
  --control CONTROL     the Worker Manager control store, opened READ-ONLY: a
                        fresh attempt is refused unless this host's own record
                        shows every prior runtime ceased and its resource
                        returned, and unknown refuses rather than proceeds
  --authority AUTHORITY
                        the Authority store whose Work this attempt runs
                        under; the prior Job's Work is reused when it is open,
                        which is what makes the installed workers able to
                        serve it
  --instance INSTANCE   the deployment's state root, whose own bootstrap
                        prepares the additive Job binding and whose selector
                        is asked whether a worker can serve each stage
  --route ROUTE         the route a Work is created under, used only when the
                        selected Work does not exist yet
  --job-id JOB_ID       the fresh Job identity; derived from the prior one
                        when omitted, so no operator or model has to invent a
                        name
  --work-id WORK_ID     the Work this attempt runs under; the prior Job's when
                        omitted
  --submission-id SUBMISSION_ID
                        the submission identity; derived from the fresh Job id
                        when omitted

manager-status.stdout:
usage: job_manager status [-h] [--control CONTROL] [--observe OBSERVE]

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --control CONTROL  the Worker Manager control store; without it the
                     projection reports canonical=false rather than an empty
                     pipeline, and with one that is driving another Job store
                     it refuses rather than projecting that store's offers as
                     these Jobs'
  --observe OBSERVE  an observation-only deployment factory as
                     module:attribute, which reconstructs this attempt's
                     durable launch and exchange files so the projection can
                     report a worker's terminal; without it the exchange is
                     reported as null, which is 'nobody looked' rather than
                     'nothing happened'. It opens no Authority and carries no
                     act, and it does not refresh the runtime axis -- that is
                     the serving loop's, because reconciling records what it
                     saw

usage: job_viewer [-h] --status STATUS [--job JOB] [--interval INTERVAL]
                  [--stage STAGE] [--artifact ARTIFACT] [--ticks TICKS]
